<issue>
Array index extraction returns incorrect tokens

#### Description

When parsing SQL identifiers with array indices, the `get_array_indices()` method returns incorrect tokens. Instead of extracting just the content inside square brackets, it's including the opening bracket and excluding the closing bracket.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlparse

# Simple array index
p = sqlparse.parse('col[1]')[0].tokens
identifier = p[0]
indices = list(identifier.get_array_indices())
print("Expected: '1'")
print(f"Actual: '{indices[0][0].value}'")

# Schema qualified array index  
p = sqlparse.parse('schema.col[1]')[0].tokens
identifier = p[0]
indices = list(identifier.get_array_indices())
print("Expected: '1'")
print(f"Actual: '{indices[0][0].value}'")

# Aliased array index
p = sqlparse.parse('col[1] x')[0].tokens
identifier = p[0]
indices = list(identifier.get_array_indices())
print("Expected: '1'")
print(f"Actual: '{indices[0][0].value}'")
```

The method should return the tokens representing the array index content (e.g., '1'), but instead returns tokens that include the opening bracket.
</issue>
